descEn: Bigger binary numbers — like a real computer!
descDa: Større binære tal — tænk som en rigtig computer!

teacherGuide.conceptGu: Advanced binary — bigger values. 8-bit thinking intro. Real computers use 8, 16, 32, 64 bits. Show connection: 8 bits = 1 byte = smallest unit of computer memory.
teacherGuide.conceptEn: 8-bit numbers, intro to bytes. Connect to real computer memory.
teacherGuide.conceptDa: Ekspert binær — større værdier. Introduktion til 8-bit tænkning. Rigtige computere bruger 8, 16, 32 eller 64 bit. 8 bit er lig med 1 byte, som er computerens mindste hukommelsesenhed.
teacherGuide.storyGu: 'Yuval, computer memory = billions of bits! 8 bits = 1 byte. 1 photo = millions of bytes! Chess story: doubling — 64 squares = 64 bits is huge number!'
teacherGuide.storyEn: Computers have billions of bits! 8 bits makes 1 byte. An image takes millions of bytes to store on a screen. Every pixel is made of bytes!
teacherGuide.storyDa: Computere har milliarder af små kontakter (bits)! 8 bits kaldes en Byte. Et billede på skærmen fylder millioner af bytes. Hver pixel er bygget af bytes!
teacherGuide.scriptGu: 'Big numbers same way — more boxes, more power. 10000 in binary = 16! Computer thinks fast because bits flip in nanoseconds!'
teacherGuide.scriptEn: Ready to go further? What if we add a 5th bit? Value is 16! Doubling never stops in computer science.
teacherGuide.scriptDa: Er du klar til at gå endnu længere? Hvis vi tilføjer en 5. bit, er dens værdi 16! Fordobling stopper aldrig i computerens verden.
teacherGuide.tipsGu: 💡 Count something big — how many bits needed? Age 7 = 3 bits. Age 100 needs 7 bits!
teacherGuide.tipsEn: 💡 Ask: How many bits to represent number 15? (4 bits: 1111). How about 16? (5 bits: 10000).
teacherGuide.tipsDa: 💡 Spørg barnet: Hvor mange bits skal vi bruge for at lave tallet 15? (4 bits: 1111). Hvad med 16? (5 bits: 10000).

questions.textDa: Hvad kaldes 8 bits, der er lagt sammen?
questions.hintEn: 8 bits = 1 Byte — the building block of all computer memory!
questions.hintDa: 8 bits = 1 Byte. Det er byggestenen i al computerhukommelse!
